description: OIXIO | Timeline Slicer is a Power BI component designed for user-friendly time filtering. It works across multiple levels of granularity—day, week, month, quarter, year—and allows dynamic selection of time ranges. The appearance of the slicer can be customized to meet your company’s branding requirements, including colors, fonts, and layout. This component is ideal for solutions where a dynamic period filter is essential upon opening a dashboard, such as “Year-to-date until last month” or “Last 12 months.” Key Features: - Compact Design: Select periods quickly using predefined shortcuts or conveniently with start and end sliders. - Flexible Time Granularity: Define the appropriate columns in your date table (week, month, year, etc.), and users can instantly switch between week, month, or year without cumbersome multiple clicks. - Default Periods: Configure up to six dynamic quick-select periods, such as “Year-to-date,” “Rolling 12 months,” or “Previous year.” These defaults are dynamic, always based on today’s date. - Customizable Appearance: Colors, fonts, and layout can be tailored to your company’s brand guidelines. When applied consistently across all reports, it creates a professional and unified look for your organization’s analytics.
